question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

**INEVITABLY**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Certainly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's understand the meaning of given words.

__
 
• **Avoidably -** *In a manner so as to be avoidable. (*इस तरह से जिससे बचा जा सके।*)*
 
• **Certainly - ***Used to express complete agreement with something that has been said. (*कही गई किसी बात से पूर्ण सहमति जताते थे।*)*
 
• **Distantly - ***Far away, not closely, or coolly or remotely. (*दूर, निकट नहीं, या शांत या दूर।*)*
 
• **Unlikely - ***Not likely to happen, be done or be true. (*होने, होने या सच होने की संभावना नहीं है।*)*
 
• **The given word "Inevitably" **means **'as is certain to happen, or impossible to avoid or prevent'**. ('जैसा होना निश्चित है, या बचना या रोकना असंभव है'।)

As per the above-mentioned detail, the adverb **'Certainly'** is the most appropriate synonym of the given word **'Inevitably'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand the meaning **with **some examples.**

 
• He **avoidably **made a mistake that was not expected.
 
• I heard, **distantly**, the sound of the chirping of birds.
 
• It's pretty **unlikely **that he will pick up your call after this blunder.
 
• **Inevitably**, somebody rang the doorbell at night.
